title: WebAssembly: Hello World
description: Write a WebAssembly text format (WAT) program that exports a function to add two numbers.

codeTemplate.wasm:
(module
  (func $add (param $a i32) (param $b i32) (result i32)
    local.get $a
    local.get $b
    i32.add)
  (export "add" (func $add))
)

hints: `local.get` pushes a local variable onto the stack
`i32.add` pops two values and pushes their sum
